echoParts: even to the end of the age
verseText: And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.
meaning: This is a promise to us from Jesus. He will always be with us, until the end of time.

recall.question: How long is Jesus with His followers?
choices: Always, to the end of the age

application.prompt: Whatever happens today, remind yourself: Jesus is with me.
